{{StoryArc|Fear.exe|Mean Gears|Dirge}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Bot Incursion [[Special Mission|Spotlight Mission]] that ran from February 10th ~ February 24th, 2022.

== Synopsis ==
Having moved past the fear Dirge placed on the natural spacebridge, Optimus and Bumblebee head out to investigate the source of the new Deceptions. What use can this bridge have? What horrors does it hold? There is much debate, even amongst the Autobots, about what to do with this dangerous gate. Will the Autobots find a way home? Or will they discover there is NO WAY BACK?
